change: Palette swap overhaul before the swapper goes in a GUI
details: Owner 2026-11-04: the whole design approach of `textureswapper/palette_swap.py` has to change before it is integrated in a GUI. Found on the jam line (`gen_jam_art.py`): the brightness-rank mapping skips non-monotonic palette colors (pepper's dark reds, darker than its browns, never appeared); `--interpolate` only blends when the palette has fewer colors than the texture, so a 23- or 25-color sample (cherry, green grape) gets no change; the rank positions are bunched (6 of 8 interior shades in the darkest quarter); semi-transparent palette pixels leak into the output (white grape). Workarounds in `gen_jam_art.py`: `palette_of` (opaque only, optional darkest dropped) and `even_swap` (forced even gradient). Redesign questions: map by hue and role instead of rank, pick the palette per shade not per brightness, per-texture ramps, preview built in.
